title: NEW VEHICLE! | Copi Cafe Episode 49
description:
Welcome to the latest episode of Copi Cafe! In this episode, Josh and Rob provide some exciting updates on our marketing strategy as we continue to grow. They also discuss the unique opportunities that our community members can take advantage of, thanks to Cornucopias' early stage of development.

The conversation then turns to testing, and the challenges we'll face as we continue to discover bugs and work to solve them. Josh also shares his insights on how we plan to integrate AI into our customer support systems as technology continues to advance.

As always, the guys answer some highly anticipated community questions before diving into a huge leak! So sit back, relax, and join us for another informative and engaging episode of Copi Cafe. Don't forget to like and subscribe for more updates on our progress.


00:00 Beverage Choices
02:38 Marketing Strategy
11:52 Testing  
23:24 AI Customer Support
25:35 Community Questions
37:45 Leak! 

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
